\emph{Answer all questions. Choose the most appropriate option for each multiple-choice question.}

\begin{enumerate}[label=Q\arabic*., leftmargin=*]
\item The roots of the quadratic equation $x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0$ are:
\\[0.5em]
\textbf{A.} $(1, 6)$\\
\textbf{B.} $(2, 3)$\\
\textbf{C.} $(3, 5)$\\
\textbf{D.} $(-2, -3)$

\item The simple interest on \rupee{}5000 at $10\%$ per annum for 2 years is:
\\[0.5em]
\textbf{A.} \rupee{}1000\\
\textbf{B.} \rupee{}1050\\
\textbf{C.} \rupee{}1100\\
\textbf{D.} \rupee{}1200

\item The derivative of $\ln(x^2+1)$ with respect to $x$ is:
\\[0.5em]
\textbf{A.} $\dfrac{1}{x}$\\
\textbf{B.} $\dfrac{2x}{x^2+1}$\\
\textbf{C.} $\dfrac{1}{x^2+1}$\\
\textbf{D.} $2x$

\item The exact value of $\cos(2\theta)$ is:
\\[0.5em]
\textbf{A.} $1 - 2\sin^2\theta$\\
\textbf{B.} $\sin^2\theta + \cos^2\theta$\\
\textbf{C.} $2\sin\theta\cos\theta$\\
\textbf{D.} $\tan\theta$

\item A fair die is rolled. The probability of getting a number greater than $4$ is:
\\[0.5em]
\textbf{A.} $\dfrac{1}{6}$\\
\textbf{B.} $\dfrac{2}{6}$\\
\textbf{C.} $\dfrac{3}{6}$\\
\textbf{D.} $\dfrac{4}{6}$

\item The determinant of the identity matrix of order $3$ is:
\\[0.5em]
\textbf{A.} $0$\\
\textbf{B.} $1$\\
\textbf{C.} $2$\\
\textbf{D.} $3$

\item $\displaystyle \lim_{x\to 0} \frac{1 - \cos x}{x^2} =$ 
\\[0.5em]
\textbf{A.} $0$\\
\textbf{B.} $\dfrac{1}{2}$\\
\textbf{C.} $1$\\
\textbf{D.} $\infty$

\item If a sum of \rupee{}10{,}000 amounts to \rupee{}12{,}100 in 2 years at compound interest, the rate per annum is:
\\[0.5em]
\textbf{A.} $5\%$\\
\textbf{B.} $10\%$\\
\textbf{C.} $12\%$\\
\textbf{D.} $15\%$

\item $\sin^2\theta + \cos^2\theta =$ 
\\[0.5em]
\textbf{A.} $0$\\
\textbf{B.} $1$\\
\textbf{C.} $\sin 2\theta$\\
\textbf{D.} $\cos 2\theta$

\item The sum of the first $n$ terms of an arithmetic progression with first term $a$ and common difference $d$ is:
\\[0.5em]
\textbf{A.} $\dfrac{n}{2}\,[2a + (n-1)d]$\\
\textbf{B.} $a^{n}$\\
\textbf{C.} $n(a+d)$\\
\textbf{D.} $(a+d)^{n}$
\end{enumerate}
